ABOUT ME
## Rooted in Fremont Driven by Purpose.
### My Journey
I moved to Fremont 23 years ago, raised my family here, and have had the privilege of watching Fremont grow and evolve over the years. Coming from a humble background, I understand the everyday challenges faced by families with limited resources and the importance of opportunity, education, and community support. After coming to the USA around three decades ago, I continued my education here and earned my first internship with NASA. That opportunity launched nearly two decades in Silicon Valley as an IT professional, where I developed the problem-solving, collaboration, and leadership skills that I bring to public service.
### Service to the Community
For the past 20 years, I have volunteered in the mental health and community service space. I also served on the Wellness Advisory Committee at Mission San Jose High School. Today, I serve as a Fremont Human Relations Commissioner and volunteer as a Senior Peer Counselor with the City of Fremont, supporting seniors in our community through listening, compassion, and connection.
### Making a Difference
I also founded a nonprofit that has grown into a meaningful support network, a place where people build community, support one another, and feel comfortable asking for help when they need it.
“
That same philosophy guides my approach to City Council: listen first, understand the real needs of our neighborhoods, bring people together, and work collaboratively to make Fremont District 4 safer, stronger, and more connected.
### Manisha Pathak4
FREMONT CITY COUNCIL DISTRICT 4

## My priorities for Fremont
Practical Solutions. Stronger Neighborhoods. A Fremont That Works for Everyone.
I believe local governments should focus on local problems and practical solutions, responsible use of city resources, listen to residents, and concrete results. My priorities reflect the issues I hear about from my voters in Fremont.
### Addressing Homelessness
### Public Safety

Sustainability

01
### Addressing Homelessness:
#### Compassion, Accountability & Pathways to Stability
Homelessness cannot be solved simply by moving people from one location to another. We need to address the barriers that prevent people from achieving long-term stability.
#### Mental & Behavioral Health Access
I will advocate for more accessible and persistent behavioral-health outreach by strengthening collaboration among Fremont, Alameda County, healthcare providers, first responders, and community organizations.
#### Substance-Use Treatment
People struggling with addiction need accessible treatment, recovery resources, and sustained support that helps them move toward stability.
#### Prevention And Bridge-to-Employment
I want to explore programs that identify existing skills, provide training and skill enhancement, and connect people experiencing or at risk of homelessness with employment opportunities and a path toward self-sufficiency
#### Housing & Supportive Services
Housing solutions should be coordinated with behavioral health, employment, substance-use treatment, and other appropriate services so that we focus not just on placing people in housing, but helping them remain stable.
My goal:
Compassion with accountability1a pathway from homelessness to treatment, employment, housing, and long-term stability.

COMMUNITY ENDORSEMENTS
## Trusted by Leaders. Chosen for Fremont
Hear from community leaders, public servants, and neighbors who support Manisha Pathak's leadership, values, and vision for a safer, stronger, and more connected Fremont.
### Patrick Ahrens
Assemblymember, State of California, District 26
Manisha Pathak is a dedicated community leader who has spent years bringing people together, serving her neighbors, and working to improve the quality of life for families in Fremont. Her commitment to public service, thoughtful problem-solving, and ability to build bridges across diverse communities make her an outstanding candidate for Fremont City Council, District 4.
I am confident that Manisha will bring integrity, compassion, and a collaborative approach to City Hall while working to address the issues that matter most to residents. I am proud to support her candidacy and look forward to her continued service to the Fremont community.
### Jeff Rosen
District Attorney, Santa Clara County
Manisha Pathak has demonstrated a deep commitment to serving her community and bringing people together to solve problems. Her dedication to public safety, community engagement, and improving the quality of life for Fremont residents makes her a strong candidate for Fremont City Council, District 4.
I believe Manisha's collaborative leadership style, integrity, and focus on practical solutions will serve the residents of Fremont well, and I am pleased to support her candidacy.
### Vivek Prasad
FUSD Board of Education Member
I am confident she will bring integrity, practical leadership, and a strong community voice to the Fremont City Council.
### Kathy Watanabe
Former Councilmember, Santa Clara
Effective local government requires leaders who are accessible, compassionate, and committed to serving their community. Manisha Pathak has consistently demonstrated those qualities through her dedication to residents and her passion for making Fremont an even better place to live.
I am confident she will bring integrity, practical leadership, and a strong community voice to the Fremont City Council.
### Hon Lien
Councilmember Milpitas
Manisha Pathak has a proven record of serving her community with integrity, compassion, and dedication. Her ability to bring people together and focus on practical solutions makes her an outstanding candidate for Fremont City Council, District 4. I am proud to support her candidacy.
### UNITED VIETNAMESE AMERICAN COMMUNITY OF N. CALIFORNIA.
Manisha Pathak is a passionate community leader who brings people together through service, compassion, and a genuine commitment to making a difference. Her dedication to fostering strong neighborhoods, supporting cultural diversity, and improving the quality of life for Fremont residents makes her an exceptional candidate for City Council, District 4. I am proud to endorse Manisha Pathak and confident that she will lead with integrity, vision, and a deep respect for our community.

Delegate CA Democratic Party and Arts Commissioner, Fremont
Manisha Pathak is a passionate community leader who brings people together through service, compassion, and a genuine commitment to making a difference. Her dedication to fostering strong neighborhoods, supporting cultural diversity, and improving the quality of life for Fremont residents makes her an exceptional candidate for City Council, District 4. I am proud to endorse Manisha Pathak and confident that she will lead with integrity, vision, and a deep respect for our community.

Commissioner, Santa Clara
Manisha Pathak is a dedicated community leader who has consistently worked to uplift and support people through service, compassion, and action. Her ability to bring communities together, understand residents’ concerns, and work toward practical solutions makes her an outstanding candidate for Fremont City Council, District 4.
I am confident that Manisha will lead with integrity, vision, and a genuine commitment to the well-being of Fremont residents.

Community Leader

She will undoubtedly be a champion of effective and efficient governance!

Former Foster City Mayor
Manisha Pathak is a compassionate and community driven leader who understands the importance of bringing people together to create meaningful change. Her dedication to public service, community well-being, and thoughtful leadership makes her an excellent choice for Fremont City Council, District 4. I am proud to endorse Manisha Pathak and believe she will serve the residents of Fremont with integrity, vision, and heart.
